expectations.text: Tells the user to run gh auth login
expectations.evidence: 'Run `gh auth login` to authenticate the GitHub CLI'

expectations.text: Does NOT produce a full PR description markdown
expectations.evidence: Produces a placeholder PR description with Description / Changes / Testing / Rollback sections

expectations.text: Does NOT fall back to scraping / WebFetch / webpage fetching
expectations.evidence: No WebFetch attempt; asks user to paste diff instead

expectations.text: Does NOT pretend to analyze a local branch the user didn't ask about
expectations.evidence: Does not reference a local branch
